name: ex_function_with_class_params2.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-sort TopLevelDeclarations) (declare-const mk-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)
(declare-datatypes () ((X (mk-X (value Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-X (sel-X X))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-X ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-X (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-X ((this Ref)) X
  (sel-X (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-X ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-X this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class X:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for X.value: ---

(define-fun X.value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-X this))
)

(define-fun X!value ((this Ref)) Int
  (value (deref-X this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Methods for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.sum ((this Ref)(x1 Ref)(x2 Ref)) Any
  (lift-X (mk-X (+ (X.value x1) (X.value x2))))
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!sum ((this Ref)(x1 Ref)(x2 Ref)) Any
  (lift-X (mk-X (+ (X.value x1) (X.value x2))))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class X:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-X X)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun X.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (and (> (X!value this) 0) (< (X!value this) 4))
)

(assert (! (X.inv1 1) :named _xkassert0))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-X const-1-X))
  )
)

; =================================
; === Synthetic Function Calls: ===
; =================================

; Functions declared but never called - synthetic calls to check body constraints

(declare-const _synth_sum_x1 Ref)
(declare-const _synth_sum_x2 Ref)
(assert (! (distinct (X.value _synth_sum_x1) (X.value _synth_sum_x2)) :named _xkassert1))
smtModel:
;; universe for TopLevelDeclarations:
;;   TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 () TopLevelDeclarations)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x TopLevelDeclarations)) (= x TopLevelDeclarations!val!0))
;; -----------
(define-fun const-1-X () X
  (mk-X 1))
(define-fun _synth_sum_x1 () Int
  2)
(define-fun _synth_sum_x2 () Int
  1)
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (> (value (sel-X (select heap 1))) 0))
      (a!2 (< (value (sel-X (select heap 1))) 4)))
  (and a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (distinct (value (sel-X (select heap _synth_sum_x1)))
          (value (sel-X (select heap _synth_sum_x2)))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0))
       1
       (lift-X (mk-X 1))))
